title: Concern for Tribals.
body: The students of our Vidyalaya visited a Tribal Colony in Wynad to hand over medicines, clothes and money. The money would be utilized to construct a well, the group had an interaction with the tribal elders and children and could gain an idea of their way of life. The students contributed willingly to purchase iron tablets, which were supplied to the tribal women of Attappady, where poverty is endemic. Responding positively towards the appeal made by Sri.Vijay Menon during his talk on 15-6-2015 students of 11th Std. generously contributed an amount of Rs.14,595/- for buying sleeping mats for the Tribals of Wyanad District. These mats were handed over to the representatives.

title: Investiture Ceremony
body: The Investiture Ceremony at Chinmaya Vidyalaya, Kolazhy, Thrissur on 27th July 2023 was a momentous occasion filled with pride and honour. The ceremony was graced by the presence of the esteemed Chief Guest, IPS Aiswarya Dongre, Rural SP, H H Swami Gabeeranandaji, Acharya, Chinmaya Mission Thrissur, Director of Education Dr V Venugopal, Principal Smt. Usha Kumari P, Vice Principal Smt Latha E T, Sr. Headmistress Smt. Bindu K and Headmaster Sri Madhavdasan K. In her inaugural address, IPS Aishwarya Dongre emphasized the importance of leadership and urged the students to embrace their roles with passion and empathy. Her inspiring words resonated with the audience, leaving them motivated and inspired to achieve greatness.

The newly appointed Office Bearers then took a solemn pledge, vowing to carry out their duties with utmost sincerity and to uphold the values of the school. In conclusion, the Investiture Ceremony at Chinmaya Vidyalaya was a remarkable event that marked the beginning of a transformative leadership journey for the newly appointed Office Bearers. With the guidance and support of the school, they are poised to make a positive impact and bring about positive change within the school and beyond. .

body: The Chinmaya Birth Centenary celebrations grand finale was held in the Chinmaya Janmashathabdi Nagar near Neeranjali hall on the 21st and the 22nd May. A versification and slogan writing competition along with an environment quiz was conducted in the following week.

title: Chinmaya Vidyalaya Model United Nations
body: Chinmaya Vidyalaya Model United Nations was organized in the school premises on September 21st, 24th and 25th. 80 participants from classes 9, 10, 11 & 12 became delegates who represented 22 countries. There were 4 committees of United Nations: - DISEC, UNHRC, UNEP and UNSC. It was inaugurated by the General Secretary -Thomas Babychan of class XII D. During the closing ceremony The City Police Commissioner of Thrissur- Sri. Yathish Chandra GH IPS, was the Chief Guest. He had an interactive session with the delegates. The best delegates were honored with trophies and certificates. The vision of CVMUN was to help our students to think beyond their limits and help them develop their diplomatic and speaking skills. The motive of CVMUN was to: Imagine, Innovate, and Inspire.

title: The 40th Annual Day Celebrations
body: Member of Parliament Shri. Suresh Gopi who is also a popular and versatile actor inaugurated the 40th Annual Day Celebrations on the 9th Feb 2019 and addressed the audience. H.H. Swami Viviktananda Saraswathi, Regional Head, Chinmaya Mission, Kerala exhorted the audience to imbibe the principles enshrined in the Chinmaya Vision Programme, through his presidential address. This was followed by an explosion of talents in the form of 'Kaladarshika' where students right from Pre-KG to Std XII were given a platform to exhibit their inherent potentials in music, dance, drama, comedy etc., individually and in large and small groups. It was indeed an audio visual treat leaving the audience wanting for more The Ruby Jubilee Celebrations culminated with the grand finale on 8th and 9th Feb 2019. A visual treat of the folk Arts of Kerala was arranged in the Vidyalaya for the students

The inaugural address by the Chief Guest Sri Jayarajan Rajasekharan Nair, a National award winning film director. It was rightly decided to begin the programmes connected with the Ruby jubilee by honouring four eminent and erudite GURU's in various fields through "GURUVANDANAM". We hope their blessing and guidance will help us scale greater heights in the years to come.

title: Annual Day: 39th celebration
body: The 39th Annual day was celeberated on 14th February 2018. The chief guest of the day was Dr V VUnnikrishnan Dean, University of Health Science. Our Vice Principal welcomed the gathering. Our Principal presented the Annual report followed by the inaugural address by the Chief Guest. Our Director G Mukundanhonoured retiring Principal SmtShobhanaDevadas on this august occasion. SmtNirmalaHaridas teacher of Commerce Departmentwas also honoured on her retirement from service. The Head boy and Head Girl shared their reminiscences. The formal programme came to an end with the vote of thanks by our Headmistress. It was followed by a cultural fiesta by the students which was well appreciated by the well-wishers for the maximum participation and grandeur.
